title: EMBRACE (EMPA in BReast Cancer for Activity and Cardiac ProtEction)
official: Cardioprotective Effects of Empagliflozin in Breast Cancer Patients Receiving Chemotherapy: A Pilot Study
summary: The primary objective of this pilot study is to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of a clinical trial protocol investigating 10 mg/day empagliflozin in breast cancer patients receiving anthracycline-based chemotherapy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Stage I-III breast cancer (including inflammatory and newly diagnosed, or locally recurrent but not metastatic breast cancer being treated with curative intent)
* 18-85 years old
* Scheduled to receive anthracycline based chemotherapy with or without estrogen antagonist aromatase inhibitors (anastrozole \[Arimidex\], letrozole \[Femara\], exemestane \[Aromasin\]).
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 - 2
* Able to walk at least 2 blocks without chest pain, dyspnea or fainting
* Participants in other ongoing clinical trials are eligible for this study
* Participants must be able to speak, read, and understand English sufficiently to provide informed consent and complete all study-related procedures and assessments.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure \>190 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure \>100 mm Hg)
* A recent history of alcohol or drug abuse
* Inflammatory conditions such as lupus or inflammatory bowel disease, or another medical condition that might compromise safety or successful completion
* Type II diabetes
* Contraindications to Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) (example: iron-based metal implants, cerebral aneurysm clip)
* Current treatment with empagliflozin at the time of screening or enrollment
* Significant ventricular arrhythmias (PVC) (\>20 PVCs/min due to gating difficulty)
* Atrial fibrillation with uncontrolled ventricular response (\>130 bpm)
* Acute myocardial infarction within 28 days
* Claustrophobia
* Pregnancy
* Those unable to provide informed consent
* Moving within 6 mos. of enrollment
* Individuals who are unable to speak, read, or understand English sufficiently to provide informed consent and complete study procedures will be excluded.
